hero_subtitle: Built for sincere Muslims seeking Nikah across cultures
what_is_tonikah_text: toNikah is not just another matrimonial app — it’s a purpose-driven platform built exclusively for Muslims seeking marriage, not dating or casual relationships. Rooted in Islamic values and designed for the modern generation, toNikah offers a respectful, user-friendly, and refined experience for those serious about Nikah.
no_match_games_text: toNikah isn’t a dating app. No endless swipes, likes, or contests. Everyone gets one respectful chance to introduce themselves. If the other replies, the conversation continues. If not, you simply move on. Every profile gets seen, no one gets lost.
hiw_subtitle: 3 Easy steps to start your Nikah journey
hiw_step2_text: See real people, not popularity games.
hiw_step3_text: One respectful message. If they reply, you connect.
verified_profile_text: Selfie verification confirms real people. Control who sees your photos with per-person access, time limits, and visibility toggles.
early_access_title: Get 1 Month Free – Register Before May 5th
early_access_text: Register now and get your first month completely free, plus 50% off a 3-month membership. Offer ends at launch.

membership.title: Membership
membership.subtitle: __PRICE__/month — One simple plan, all features unlocked
membership.body: At toNikah, we don’t believe in free swipes or half-access. Our __PRICE__ membership ensures that everyone here is serious about Nikah, not wasting time. With one affordable fee, you get full access to all features — no games, no hidden limits.

membership_reason.title: Why only paid membership?
membership_reason.body: Free apps attract people looking for time-pass, not marriage. With a small __PRICE__/month membership, toNikah keeps the community serious, sustainable, and free from ads or tricks. Unlike other platforms that make you wait and play swiping games, here the path is simple and direct. Because every member pays, it also becomes easier to verify accounts and reduce fake profiles. The fee is affordable worldwide, and if someone is truly ready for marriage, they can value this small commitment.
membership_reason.highlight: And for sisters in need, in selected countries we’ll sponsor memberships through gift cards.

vision.text_outro: We envision a platform where faith, culture, and technology come together to guide Muslims toward meaningful and lasting marriages.

goal.title: Our Goal
goal.intro: Our goal is to create a safe, respectful, and purpose-driven space where Muslims can:

list.item1: Connect with Muslims who are sincerely seeking a spouse through Nikah.
list.item2: Learn from Qur’an and Hadith about marriage and family life.
list.item3: Discover wedding cultures, traditions, and trends from different regions.
list.item4: Connect with content that educates, inspires, and prepares them for Nikah.

achieve.title: What We Want to Achieve
achieve.text: toNikah is more than just an app — it’s a community built to revive the true spirit of Nikah. Our aim is not only to help Muslims connect with their future spouses but also to guide, inspire, and prepare them for lasting family life.

vision.outro: . Many challenges in marriage arise from limited knowledge of Islamic teachings and relationships. Through our content, we aim to guide couples with lessons from Qur’an and Hadith, and highlight global Muslim wedding traditions.

header.title: Your Safety, Our Priority
header.subtitle: We are committed to keeping ToNikah respectful and secure for everyone.

privacy.title: Protect your privacy
privacy.text: Keep your personal details safe. Avoid sharing your phone number, home address, workplace, or financial information until you truly know and trust the person.

verified_profiles.title: Trust verified profiles
verified_profiles.text: Give preference to members with verification badges. These profiles have passed our security checks, offering you extra confidence while connecting.

report_block.title: Report & block
report_block.text: If someone makes you uncomfortable or acts suspiciously, don’t hesitate to block them. Use the report feature so our team can take action quickly.

photo_privacy.title: Photo privacy
photo_privacy.text: Your gallery is under your control. Share images only with people you trust, decide the duration of access, and revoke it anytime you feel unsure.

meeting_guidelines.title: Meeting Guidelines
meeting_guidelines.public_places: 🏦 Meet in public places – Always arrange your first meetings in safe, public areas such as cafes or parks, never in private or isolated spaces.
meeting_guidelines.inform_friends: 👨‍👩‍👧 Inform family or friends – Let someone you trust know where you’re going, who you’re meeting, and when you expect to return.
meeting_guidelines.take_your_time: 🕰️ Take your time – Don’t rush into making big decisions. A genuine connection will develop naturally without pressure.

avoiding_scams.title: Avoiding Scams
avoiding_scams.never_send_money: ⚠️ Never send money or gifts – Be cautious of anyone asking for financial help, no matter how convincing their story sounds.
avoiding_scams.watch_for_red_flags: 🚩 Watch for red flags – Requests for secrecy, urgent demands, or inconsistent stories are common signs of fraud.
avoiding_scams.report_suspicious_behavior: 📢 Report suspicious behavior – If you notice anything unusual, report it immediately so our team can protect the community.

launch.subtitle_pre: For every Muslim who believed the search for a spouse should feel
launch.beta_body: We're in beta, and that makes you special. We're young, we're learning, and yes — there may be the occasional bug. If something feels off, please don't close the tab in frustration. Come tell us. Every report, every message, every piece of feedback is a brick in this house we're building together. Let's build the most halal, most honest place to find your spouse — together. JazakAllah khayran for your trust and patience. It truly means everything to us. 🤍

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before signing up.
faq.a1: During signup, you capture a live selfie that we compare against your profile photos. Only verified members can browse or message — no bots, no catfishing, no second accounts.
faq.q2: Why is toNikah a paid-only community?
faq.a2: A small membership fee filters out curiosity signups and keeps the community focused on Nikah. Everyone you meet has committed something real to be here — that changes the conversations.
faq.q3: How is this different from dating apps?
faq.a3: No swiping. No popularity scores. No matching gates. You browse every profile, send one respectful intro per person, and if they reply, the conversation begins. Built for Nikah, not entertainment.
faq.a4: You control per-person visibility. Grant access to specific people, set a time window, or revoke at any moment. Your private gallery stays private until you decide otherwise.
faq.a5: Yes. You can nominate a wali or family reference on your profile, and members can contact them directly — keeping the process transparent and in line with Islamic tradition.
faq.q6: What if the person doesn't reply?
faq.a6: That's okay — intent matters both ways. Their profile returns to your browse list, and you can focus on others. No badges, no penalties, no pressure.

testimonials.title: Real people. Real intent.
testimonials.t1: Finally a platform that respects the intent of Nikah. The selfie verification and no-swipe system made me feel safe from day one.
testimonials.t2: One intro message per profile forces you to be thoughtful. No swiping fatigue, no popularity contests — just real people with real intent.
testimonials.t3: The private gallery control is brilliant — I decide who sees my photos and for how long. That kind of respect for privacy is rare.
testimonials.t4: A paid-only community keeps it serious. Everyone here is ready for Nikah, not timepass. The price is more than fair.
